title: Introduce Interaction as Proper Resource
prompt: Introduce `interaction` as a proper resource. Interactions are aggregated from other resources that have interactions (e.g. tickets and goals). Add it to GraphQL schema. Add `interaction list` to the CLI (not MCP) that lists all interactions. With `--sorted` the list is not streamed but sorted by date. Add `interaction tree` to the CLI (not MCP) showing interactions within the parent tree (goal -> ticket tree extended with interaction items).
